extraction.document_summary: FWD Life PA is a guaranteed renewable personal accident insurance plan that provides lifetime coverage up to age 100, as long as premiums are paid on time. It centres on an Accidental Death and Disability Benefit (ADDB) with three base sum insured options: S$100,000, S$200,000, and S$500,000. Depending on the accident outcome, it can pay 100% of the ADDB sum insured for accidental death, and for accidental permanent disability it pays up to 150% of the ADDB sum insured. It can also provide multiple indemnities (double and triple) when accidental death/permanent disability occurs in specified transport/travel situations. The plan includes a Compassionate Grant Benefit (10% of ADDB) and accident-related inpatient/outpatient medical expense reimbursement (up to S$2,000 / S$3,000 / S$4,000 per accident), expiring at age 80. Optional riders include a Catch-All Rider (extra 10% of ADDB if ICU stay with invasive life support lasts 120+ consecutive hours) and an Income Support Rider offering Plan A/B/C daily hospital income (S$100/S$150/S$300 per day up to 365 days; halved for certain groups) and weekly income (S$100/S$200/S$350 per week up to 104 weeks; halved for certain groups; expires at age 75).

policies.quick_summary: Guaranteed renewable personal accident insurance (coverage up to age 100) with base ADDB sum insured options (S$100,000 / S$200,000 / S$500,000), accident medical reimbursement, compassionate grant, and potential double/triple indemnity in specified travel situations. Optional riders include an Income Support Rider (daily/weekly hospital income with Plan A/B/C) and a Catch-All Rider (extra 10% for certain ICU stays). Free-look cancellation window is 14 calendar days if no claim is made. Coverage is subject to underwriting and policy contract terms, including pre-existing conditions and exclusions.
